resources.string: Encryption is required for “%1$s”, but the PC or NAS does not offer it right now. Nothing is transferred. Possible causes: the setting on the NAS or PC was changed, or someone is interfering with the connection on the network.
Afterwards the profile also transfers without encryption. There is no automatic switch to ‹Required› any more.
Encryption not available: the PC or NAS does not offer it right now. This profile is paused and nothing is transferred.
Encryption automatically set to ‹Required› because your PC encrypts. This protects against a silent downgrade.
Afterwards, transfers of this profile are no longer safe from eavesdropping. LeoSync will never again switch this profile to ‹Required› automatically.
With ‹If possible› and ‹Off›, LeoSync never switches automatically.
The profile stays paused until you choose to continue.
LeoSync remembers the new drive and then checks the PC folder with a spot check. Only continue if you caused the change yourself.

Tip: Free up phone storage only after a sync, most safely with “Free up space” in LeoSync. It only deletes photos that are verified to be on the PC. Google Photos can delete originals before they are backed up.
After the import: one step left
Your profiles are waiting for their first run. Finish the steps and everything works as before.
Your trash is moving to the new folder “@LeoSync-Bin” as soon as pending restores are done. Until then, files stay in the old folder “.LeoSync-Bin”. Nothing is lost.
A restore failed several times and is holding up the move. Try it again or discard it.
Your PC or NAS rejects the folder name “@LeoSync-Bin”. LeoSync therefore keeps using “.LeoSync-Bin” there. This is normal; your files are protected.

Windows: open PowerShell as administrator. One share: Set-SmbShare -Name <ShareName> -EncryptData $true. All shares: Set-SmbServerConfiguration -EncryptData $true. Synology and QNAP: turn on SMB 3 and encryption (transport encryption) in the SMB settings. Older devices or Linux Samba without SMB 3 cannot do this; then choose “If possible”.
Otherwise you will not know when a sync is done or needs your decision.
Needed so LeoSync can back up your photos.
So LeoSync runs reliably in the background.
Without the battery exception, Android can delay or skip automatic syncs.
A sync had to run without a foreground notification.

1. Tap “Open app settings” (App info of LeoSync). 2. Choose “Battery”, “Battery usage” or “App battery management”. 3. Choose “Unrestricted” (on some phones “Allow background activity” or “Not optimised”). 4. Return to LeoSync. The labels depend on the manufacturer; some phones also need “Auto launch”.
Read where your photos were taken?

For country folders, LeoSync reads the capture location from your photos (GPS data in the photo) to choose the folder. The location is evaluated only on your phone; LeoSync does not store or send it separately. The photos themselves are transferred unchanged.
Move from the old LeoSync version?
You move your profiles with a backup. It takes a few steps.
Move from the old LeoSync version
1. Pause all profiles in the old app.

2. In the old app: Settings → export a backup and save the file. Choose an export password: then the SMB passwords are saved encrypted in the file. Without one, the file contains no passwords and you enter them again after the import.
4. Then follow the “After the import” checklist on the home screen.
5. Uninstall the old app only when everything works.
Important: do not let both apps sync the same folders at the same time. Pause all profiles in the old app before you start here, and uninstall it only when everything works.

Security: the backup file contains your profile settings and server addresses. SMB passwords are only included if you choose an export password, and then they are encrypted. Keep the file safe and delete it after the import.
Updates are delivered through Google Play.

The PC replied unencrypted although the connection should be encrypted. The connection was closed for safety and nothing was transferred. Possible causes: someone is interfering with the connection on the network, or the PC is misconfigured.

The PC no longer signs its replies, although it used to. The connection was closed for safety and nothing was transferred. Possible causes: the setting on the NAS or PC was changed, or someone is interfering with the connection on the network.

The server used to sign the connection of “%1$s”, now it does not. Without signing, the connection can be altered unnoticed. Possible causes: the setting on the NAS or PC was changed, or someone is interfering with the connection on the network. Until you decide, this profile stays paused.
Afterwards, the connection of this profile can be altered unnoticed. Only choose this if you changed the setting on the NAS or PC yourself. On the next run LeoSync remembers the new state.
Messengers often shrink photos. The file with the higher resolution usually has the better quality.
